# fabric_facility_ports (Data Source)

Decode FABRIC advertised resources into typed facility-port data.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `excludes` (String) Comma-separated site codes to exclude.
- `force_refresh` (Boolean) Whether to bypass cached resource information.
- `includes` (String) Comma-separated site codes to include.
- `name` (String) Optional exact facility port name filter.

### Read-Only

- `facility_ports` (Attributes List) Typed FABRIC facility-port resource data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--facility_ports))
- `id` (String) Synthetic data source identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--facility_ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `facility_ports`

Read-Only:

- `bandwidth` (Number) Advertised facility-port bandwidth in Gbps.
- `name` (String) Facility port name.
- `site` (String) Site that advertises the facility port.
- `switch` (String) Switch that hosts the facility port when advertised.
- `vlan_range` (String) Advertised VLAN range for the facility port.
